# AMH — Future Site Kits / Collection 01

Three independent, local-only static foundations: **FORM** (barber), **DAYFOLD** (cafe), and **AFTERFRAME** (creator). These are design concepts, not live businesses or clients. Names are provisional and not trademark-cleared. No real customer, location, review, revenue, booking, contact, or payment claims are included.

## Open and reuse

Extract the full ZIP and open `index.html` in a modern browser. Each kit also opens independently via its own `index.html`. Everything uses relative paths, native HTML/CSS/JavaScript, local SVGs, and system fonts. No install, keys, tracking, database, API, or internet connection is needed. If your browser restricts local files, serve this directory with a trusted static server (for example `python -m http.server 8000`) and open its local URL.

- `barber/`: premium architectural service layout; near-black, ivory, lime; gallery filtering.
- `cafe/`: warm editorial cafe layout; cream, rust, olive; menu filtering.
- `creator/`: cinematic project layout; midnight, violet, orange; project filters and detail dialog.
- `index.html`, `index.css`, `index.js`: searchable collection browser.
- `manifest.json`: configuration / intended destinations / release gates.
- `build-log.json`, `build-log.csv`: inventory, file hashes, origin and transfer status.
- `qa-report.md`, `qa-results.json`: actual verification scope and limits.
- `tools/check.py`: repeatable dependency-free structural checks (Python 3; JS syntax check additionally requires Node).

Read each kit's README before customizing. Content lives in HTML and (where present) project data in JavaScript. CSS variables define the visual tokens. The manifest is an editorial handoff, **not a runtime CMS**: changing it does not silently rewrite pages.

## Before any public launch

1. Confirm business/creator identity and name rights. Replace concept branding and preview copy.
2. Obtain owner approval for every claim, service, menu item, price, biography, image, and portfolio entry. Illustrations are not evidence of actual work.
3. Add only verified phone/email/address/social/contact destinations. Connect actual booking/order/payment systems only when authorized. Do not turn sample controls into pretend submissions.
4. Check menu allergen information, policies, local requirements, privacy disclosures and rights with the owner or relevant professional.
5. Re-test mobile widths, keyboard focus, reduced motion, filters, dialog dismissal and navigation after customization. Add real content alt text.
6. Keep preview `noindex` until approval; then deliberately set production indexing, real domain metadata, canonical URLs and social share assets. `noindex` is not access control.
7. Obtain separate publication authorization. Nothing in this package is deployed.

## Original assets and rights

All included SVG artwork and marks were authored specifically for this collection as code-native geometric vectors; no stock photographs, downloaded logos, external fonts, or generated raster assets are used. See provenance in the build log. They are reusable starting points; no guarantee of trademark uniqueness or legal clearance is implied. SVG wordmarks may use system-font fallbacks; outline approved typography in a design tool before print production. Transparent logo canvases and favicon files are supplied per kit.

## Storage and handoff truth

Created in the cloud workspace at `/workspace/shared/future-site-kits-20261029`.
Intended Windows destination: `D:\AMH\FutureSiteKits\2026-10-29-collection-01`.
**D: is not mounted here, and no D: transfer has been performed.** Drive upload and Git synchronization are separate parent-task steps and are not asserted by this package. No Dylan or WALO project was changed.

This is a finite first batch of 3 deliberately distinct foundations, not a claim of ongoing unattended generation.

# FORM / Barber concept

Internal AMH future-site foundation. **Not an operating business. Do not publish as a real shop.**

## Preview
Open `index.html`, or serve this directory using `python3 -m http.server 8000` and visit localhost:8000. No build, dependencies, network calls, cookies or analytics. All navigation remains local. Menu closes on selection/Escape and gallery filters update accessible status.

## Customize safely
1. Replace FORM with the client's verified trading name in HTML and original vector marks (the concept name is not trademark-cleared).
2. Replace the design narrative and example service structure with approved real content. Do not invent prices, team biographies, results, testimonials, locations or hours.
3. Replace or retain the explicitly illustrated art; obtain rights and consent for client photos. Keep meaningful alt text.
4. Add a booking/contact destination only after verifying its owner, URL and operational readiness. No business enquiry UI exists in this preview.
5. Update colors in CSS variables; tune spacing/type separately rather than reusing across unrelated brands.
6. Review business terms, privacy requirements, accessibility and mobile behavior before publication. Remove preview notices/noindex only after approval and factual verification.

## Asset inventory / provenance
`assets/logo.svg` — original transparent geometric vector wordmark.
`assets/favicon.svg` — original geometric F icon.
`assets/hero.svg` — original vector barber chair and architectural-light illustration.
`assets/shears.svg`, `assets/mirror.svg`, `assets/comb.svg` — original vector concept studies.
All authored as SVG source for this kit on 2026-10-29; no stock, scraped, generated raster or third-party fonts. Logos have not been trademark searched. Source files are editable.

## Design character
Dark utilitarian luxury; acid-green accents, oversized compact sans type, split art hero, ordered service list and filterable studies. System fonts, responsive grids, visible focus, reduced-motion support, viewport safe-area padding.

## Delivery
Cloud workspace source. Intended future local destination: `D:/AMH/FutureSiteKits/barber`. This kit has NOT been saved to that drive or deployed. See collection-level build log for QA status.

# DAYFOLD — editorial café concept

Internal AMH future-build kit. NOT an operating business. The working name is not trademark-cleared. Never present this preview as a real café.

## Preview
Open `index.html` directly, or serve this directory with `python3 -m http.server 8080`. No install, build process, external fonts, analytics, network images, accounts or API credentials are needed. JavaScript enhances mobile navigation and menu filters; all content remains available without JavaScript.

## Design
Warm cream, rust and olive; editorial serif headings; arch-framed original tabletop illustration; asymmetric hero; notebook story section. Assets are original code-native SVG, not generated photos and not licensed stock. Logo and favicon have transparent backgrounds. SVG text uses system fonts and can render slightly differently across systems; convert lettering to paths in your design editor when an exact brand master is approved.

## Before publication
1. Clear the real brand name and replace logo, page title, metadata and copy.
2. Replace the illustrative menu with verified dishes, prices, ingredients, allergens and availability. Do not use concept text as factual information.
3. Replace the story and concept note with approved copy or remove those sections.
4. Add only verified address, hours and contact/booking links. None are currently wired or implied.
5. Add rights-cleared real photography if desired; keep useful alt text.
6. Review privacy, accessibility and any applicable local business requirements with the owner.
7. Remove the preview banner and noindex metadata ONLY after content approval and intentional publication.
8. Test phone navigation, keyboard focus, menu filters, contrast and target-device rendering.

## Files
- `index.html`: complete one-page layout and disclosure copy.
- `styles.css`: responsive layout, safe-area padding, reduced-motion support.
- `script.js`: mobile menu (including Escape) and accessible menu filters.
- `assets/logo.svg`, `assets/favicon.svg`: original transparent brand studies.
- `assets/morning-table.svg`, `assets/coffee-notes.svg`: original editorial illustrations.
- `config.json`: handoff manifest, not a runtime CMS. Edit the HTML directly.

No forms, checkout, reviews, invented location, business claims or dummy contact buttons are included. Intended eventual destination: `D:/AMH/FutureSiteKits/cafe`; this cloud kit is NOT evidence that files were saved to that drive.

An internal AMH preview foundation, not a real creator identity or published portfolio. No clients, achievements, business details, contact addresses or services are asserted. All three projects are explicitly concept artwork.

Midnight / violet / burnt-orange cinematic art direction. Oversized tightly tracked sans typography, full-width artwork screen, staggered project scale, lilac process section. System fonts keep this self-contained. Independent from the other kits; not a color-swapped template.

## Customize before publication
1. Replace the fictional AFTERFRAME name and SVG logo with a verified, cleared identity. Trademark availability has **not** been researched.
2. Replace concept projects and their JavaScript dialog data with rights-cleared actual project media and truthful context. Never imply these studies are paid client work.

4. Replace the guide link with a verified destination only when ready. No fake contact or social links exist.
5. Verify all public claims, image rights, accessibility, privacy obligations and contact handling. Add legal pages if appropriate to the actual site.
6. Remove the internal-preview strip and `noindex,nofollow` only after approval to publish.

All five SVGs are original code-native vectors created for this internal kit on 2026-10-29: `logo.svg`, `favicon.svg`, `orbit.svg`, `signal.svg`, `still.svg`. No third-party imagery, fonts, trademarks or stock licenses are embedded. Logo and favicon have transparent canvases. Illustration backgrounds are intentionally opaque. Mobile menu uses expanded state and closes on navigation/Escape. Portfolio filters announce visible result counts. Local internal preview only. Not published, uploaded or copied to D:. Intended collection destination: `D:/AMH/FutureSiteKits/creator` (pending actual transfer).
